identifies_situation.instructions: The report's flagged transactions and labels make the expected_situation evident to a bank fraud analyst. If expected_situation says there is no fraud, this is true when the report flags nothing or only a few rows.

criteria: Useless: no flags or no context
Weak: flags rows but labels are missing or wrong
Good: flags the right rows with a plausible pattern label
Excellent: complete, correctly labelled, nothing spurious
usefulness.instructions: How useful is this report to an analyst deciding what to do next?
